events.headline: Iran launches missile/drone strikes on US bases and allies in Jordan, Kuwait and Bahrain after US strikes on Iranian military targets; heaviest US-Iran exchange in over a month
UAE condemns Iran's 'hostile attacks' across the Gulf region as fighting with the US expands, following strikes on Jordan, Kuwait, Bahrain and Iraq's Kurdistan region

Escalating US-Iran conflict sends oil prices to a five-week high and pushes US Treasury yields to their highest level in nearly three years; Brent still elevated near $95/bbl and WTI up ~10% on the week as of Sept 4
China's widened rare-earth/critical-mineral export controls keep global bottleneck in place; yttrium shipments to Japan hit zero and NdPr pricing up 21% in a month
